_about.purpose: Held-out validation set for the calibration fix, in the same format and structure as evaluation_set.json. Three goals in domains evaluation_set.json does not cover: health and fitness, language learning, and event planning.
_about.why_separate: The hard negatives in evaluation_set.json and the trap templates in hard_negative_templates.json were written by the same author. Measuring the calibration fix only against evaluation_set.json would be teaching to the test: any improvement could be an artifact of the templates mirroring the patterns they are scored against. The hard negatives here were written fresh, from what a real person would plausibly have open in each domain, deliberately NOT by paraphrasing the trap templates. None of the eight template patterns (bare Google search, BBC News figures piece, 'how I X in 10 minutes' YouTube tutorial, Which? best-of, r/AskReddit complaint, Instagram memes, Amazon deals, Daily Mail celebrity interview) is reproduced here.
_about.format: Window strings use the live format engine.py builds at line 111: 'AppName - Window Title'.

categories.focused: Windows that genuinely serve the goal. Expected ON TASK.
categories.distraction: Clearly unrelated windows, no shared vocabulary. Expected OFF TASK.
categories.hard_negative: Genuinely off task, but sharing vocabulary with the goal. Expected OFF TASK.

_about.limitation: Title only, like evaluation_set.json. Says nothing about the accessibility-API enrichment path.
